en-US.author: campfirium
en-US.longDescription:
Foliole is an approachable incremental reading app: it helps you work through reading material by extracting passages, creating cloze deletions, and scheduling reviews, so reading actually completes.

Core features

Native incremental reading
Built around Piotr Wozniak's incremental reading ideas, with a native workflow for extracting passages, creating cloze deletions, and refining materials without leaving the reading flow.

Integrated FSRS scheduling
Integrates FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler), an open and efficient review scheduling algorithm.

Bring reading materials together
Handles reading materials from different sources, whether local files, web documents, notes managed in Obsidian, materials exported from Readwise Reader, or selected text captured from other apps.

Index external documents
Indexes other local folders on your computer without copying or moving the original files, creating an external document library that can be searched, viewed, and used across supported clients.

Complex content support
Supports Markdown, PDF, EPUB, LaTeX math, code blocks, and other content rendering needs.

Command-line and agent workflows
Lets Terminal and local agents read, write, and organize materials in Foliole, while Foliole Aide brings Codex directly into the app using the allowance included in your ChatGPT plan.
en-US.name: Foliole
en-US.releaseNotes:
New
- Dive Flow: Read and review within a Dive, and switch between Flows while reading.
- WebDAV sync: Selected devices can relay encrypted sync changes through WebDAV between LAN sync sessions, extending LAN sync across networks.
- Custom reminders: Reminders can be triggered at specified times or under certain conditions on selected devices, with configurable notification destinations.
- Custom CSS: CSS snippets can be used to customize the app’s appearance.
- The current material can be converted to HTML and sent to a browser such as Edge to use TTS features like Read Aloud.
Improved
- Local network sync is substantially faster.
- Flow's Later action now supports a configurable fixed interval.
- Topic postponement now supports days in addition to weeks.
- Reading positions now sync across devices.
- FSRS advanced settings allow adjustment of recent review weighting and the interval penalty.
- 📱 App-wide text size is now adjustable.
- 📱 Dismissed and shelved topics can now be hidden in the directory and browse lists.
- 📱 Images in Items can be enlarged during review.
- 📱 The next chapter can be opened directly from the end of the current one.
Fixed
- Sync continues for other entries when an individual entry temporarily cannot be applied.
- Long articles reopen at the last reading position after the text reflows.
- Fonts with a single weight display bold text correctly.
- 📱 Deleting affected annotations with leading or trailing spaces clears the corresponding highlights right away.

zh-CN.description: 一款现代的渐进阅读软件
zh-CN.longDescription:
Foliole 是一款现代的渐进阅读软件：通过摘录、挖空与复习调度帮助你真正读完阅读材料。

核心功能

原生支持渐进阅读
践行 Piotr Woźniak 的渐进阅读理念，支持在深度阅读中无缝摘录、流畅挖空、持续重构。

集成 FSRS 调度
集成 FSRS（Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler），采用开源高效的复习调度算法。

汇聚阅读材料
可集中处理各种来源的阅读材料，无论是本地文件、网页文档、Obsidian 管理的笔记、Readwise Reader 导出的材料，还是从其他应用中收集的选中文字。

索引外部文档
无需复制或移动原文件，即可索引电脑上的其他本地文件夹，建立可在各平台客户端查阅和调用的外部文档库。

支持复杂材料
支持 Markdown、PDF、EPUB 等文件格式，以及数学公式（LaTeX）、代码块等内容渲染。

命令行与 Agent 工作流
终端和本地 Agent 可以读取、写入和整理 Foliole 中的资料；Foliole Aide 则让你直接在应用中使用 Codex，并使用 ChatGPT 套餐自带的 Codex 额度。
